Graphics locks, valid-only polygon drafts, reset/undo and cold persistence apply. One native feathered-polygon/rectangle nested edit and four scoped geometry/interior-color pairs are bounded; broader masks/media/full alpha/raster/live sound remain unqualified.

controls.label: Move group clip
controls.meaning: Moves the group clip and all descendant starts and keys together, preserving durations and source phase.
limitations: Programme seconds; UI commits on the selected delivery-frame grid. Pointer gestures commit once, and keyboard arrows nudge one frame (Shift: ten). Graphics or any owned child-track lock blocks the entire operation.

Group trim limits visibility and derived linked motion cue ranges; hidden keys, source phase and child timing stay editable. Moving carries descendant group/clip starts and motion/3D keys in one transaction. Bounds protect non-negative owned keys and the current programme range.
Source-occurrence attachment/remapping, group split/duplicate, time stretching, broad video/owned 3D/deeper/audio cases and continuous/full preview picture/sound remain unqualified.

controls.label: Group clip In
controls.meaning: Sets the start of the group’s half-open programme visibility range without changing child content phase.
limitations: Programme seconds; UI commits on the selected delivery-frame grid. Pointer gestures commit once, and keyboard arrows nudge one frame (Shift: ten). Graphics or any owned child-track lock blocks the entire operation.

limitations: Programme seconds; UI commits on the selected delivery-frame grid. Pointer gestures commit once, and keyboard arrows nudge one frame (Shift: ten). Graphics or any owned child-track lock blocks the entire operation.

controls.label: Selected keyframe time scale
controls.meaning: Scales selected key spacing from the first selected key, retaining property values, curves and ownership.
limitations: A finite factor greater than zero and at most100 is accepted. Scaling is not animated.
The first selected key stays fixed. Programme-range overflow or collisions reject the operation. Every selected track must be unlocked.
Group opacity and ordinary multi-property time scaling use the existing canonical key graph and history. Broad media/retiming/full picture and sound qualification remains open.

controls.label: Keyframe paste destination
controls.meaning: Chooses original owners or a compatible current-project visual layer for copied property animation.
controls.unit: layer ID; empty means original layers
limitations: Only one copied source owner may be remapped to a destination. Property identities are retained; unsupported properties and destination value ranges reject the whole paste.
Destination locks, half-frame collisions and programme overflow reject atomically. Original-layers mode checks original owner locks.
Clipboard is timeline-local; cross-project/system clipboard interchange is not qualified. Whole picture/sound agreement remains partial.

controls.label: Start velocity
controls.meaning: Sets signed endpoint change per programme second for the selected incoming key interval.
limitations: Writes the existing cubic curve; no independent velocity state is saved. Editing an easing preset explicitly converts it to a custom cubic.
Only changing intervals support these controls. Hold and constant intervals cannot be reshaped into movement. Cubic time handles stay0–1 and value handles stay-2–2; impossible speeds reject.

Native image X-curve history/cold/export evidence is scoped. Worker custom curves use32 samples; whole raster/live sound, broad media/retiming and dedicated spatial tangent handles remain unqualified.

controls.label: Kinetic unit
controls.meaning: Sets unit when creating ordinary editable text units and motion keys.
limitations: Authoring input; the generated ordinary layers and motion keys are the saved state. Later changes use the existing property timeline.
The edit must satisfy timing, layer-count and supported title-style validation.

controls.label: Import animated graphics
controls.meaning: Imports authored graphics as ordinary editable titles, artwork, groups, static geometric masks and transform keys.
limitations: AutoPromote graphics v1 JSON; matching programme aspect; timing inside the current programme; at most 128 total graphic layers and 32 new groups; 256 keys per item, 8192 imported keys and 4MiB file size.
Static SVG artwork passes the existing sanitizer and is rasterized to at most 2048 pixels on its longest side. Source vector paths are not editable after import.
Adds layers and leaves current footage/audio decisions in place. Invalid or stale imports commit no layers; successful import is one undo step.
Whole preview/final raster, live sound, broad media combinations and creative/pro/production qualification remain separate.
Optional title strokeWidth 0–8 and strokeColor hex fields use the ordinary title controls and CPU rasterizer.
Optional layer/group masks use the existing enabled, shape, percentage-polygon path, radius, feather and inversion fields. Masks remain editable in Composite; imported masks are static.

controls.label: Composition layers / Sequence tracks
controls.meaning: Switches between the actual composition stack and source/audio sequence tracks. Layer rows expose native selection, move/trim and inline transform keys.
limitations: Display choices do not mutate the canonical project. Source footage remains a base stage; clip timing alone does not certify visible pixels. Whole preview/final picture and sound remain unqualified.

controls.label: At playhead
controls.meaning: Filters layer rows by their real half-open timing range intersected with every parent group gate. It does not test opacity or occlusion.
limitations: Display choices do not mutate the canonical project. Source footage remains a base stage; clip timing alone does not certify visible pixels. Whole preview/final picture and sound remain unqualified.

controls.label: Replace entire sequence
controls.meaning: Replaces source clips at the same programme length while preserving graphics and soundtrack timing. Removes source captions/camera/template bindings. Undo restores the original source state.
limitations: Whole preview/final picture and audio, broader combinations and professional/production qualification remain separate.

Ready video at least as long as the programme; unlocked Video track; source speed 1, no speed keys, opening hook or silence removal. Graphic/sound timing remains intact; source-specific decisions are reset.

controls.label: Remove unused media
controls.meaning: Removes unreferenced project-library assets and animation keys with no remaining layer. Retains active sources, camera/audio references and pending uploads. Undo restores entries; stored files remain available.
limitations: Whole preview/final picture and audio, broader combinations and professional/production qualification remain separate.

controls.label: Outline color
controls.meaning: Sets the ordinary title outline color in saved state, native preview and CPU output. Outline width remains the existing title property.
limitations: Whole preview/final picture and audio, broader combinations and professional/production qualification remain separate.

controls.label: Logo motion brand name
controls.meaning: Names the authored composition. SVG builds create measured editable brand letters; image builds preserve supplied lettering.
limitations: Creation option. After building, edit the ordinary generated layers and keys through the standard controls.

controls.label: Logo motion duration
controls.meaning: Sets the duration of the created intro, within the current programme length. It does not stretch existing footage.
limitations: Creation option. After building, edit the ordinary generated layers and keys through the standard controls.

controls.label: Logo motion accent
controls.meaning: Sets the six-digit colour of the authored broadcast pulse, sweep and rule, preserving supplied logo colours.
limitations: Creation option. After building, edit the ordinary generated layers and keys through the standard controls.

controls.label: Add background
controls.meaning: Adds the composition backdrop over source footage; disable to retain the underlying picture.
limitations: Creation option. After building, edit the ordinary generated layers and keys through the standard controls.

controls.label: Separate left symbol from wordmark
controls.meaning: Finds a transparent seam so the original symbol and lettering can move independently. It rejects an opaque cut rather than erasing artwork.
limitations: Creation option. After building, edit the ordinary generated layers and keys through the standard controls.

controls.label: Logo symbol width
controls.meaning: Places the initial symbol/wordmark boundary as a percentage of the visible image width; the seam follows transparent space around it.
limitations: Creation option. After building, edit the ordinary generated layers and keys through the standard controls.
